Markets.title: US stocks: Nasdaq ends lower as oil prices surge ahead of earnings, economic data
Markets.summary: The Nasdaq closed lower while the energy sector thrived as oil prices surged following attacks on a Saudi airport. Investors grew increasingly cautious ahead of major bank earnings reports and due to inflation concerns caused by the rising oil costs.

Markets.title: Cleveland Fed's Hammack backs restrictive policy, says better if it comes 'relatively quickly'
Markets.summary: Cleveland Federal Reserve President Beth Hammack supports quickly implementing a restrictive monetary policy to combat broad inflation. She emphasizes the need for prompt rate adjustments and transparent communication to help households and businesses plan during rising prices.

Markets.title: US Stocks: Dating app Bumble shares surge 52% on talks to go private at $1 billion valuation
Markets.summary: Bumble shares surged nearly 52% following reports of advanced negotiations to be acquired by Ithaca Holdings. The potential private acquisition would value the dating app company at approximately $1 billion.

Markets.title: US bank stocks near correction as earnings loom, consumer outlook in focus
Markets.summary: US bank stocks are approaching correction territory ahead of their earnings reports. Investors are closely monitoring consumer resilience, borrowing costs, and credit affordability amid rising Treasury yields.

Markets.title: Polycab India’s F&O exit: NSE sets December 30 deadline; NCLAT stays insolvency order
Markets.summary: The National Stock Exchange will remove Polycab India from its equity derivatives segment on December 30, 2026. Meanwhile, the NCLAT has temporarily halted insolvency proceedings against the company related to an alleged operational debt of Rs 2.79 crore.

Markets.title: Indian Gas Exchange secures Sebi's nod to float IPO
Markets.summary: Indian Gas Exchange has received regulatory approval from Sebi to launch an initial public offering. The upcoming IPO consists entirely of an offer for sale of equity shares by its promoter, Indian Energy Exchange.

Geo-Political.title: Six Ukrainian energy sites hit by Russia since Trump announced ceasefire, Zelensky says
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Russia has struck six Ukrainian energy facilities since U.S. President Donald Trump announced a proposed ceasefire. These attacks occurred despite an agreement that energy infrastructure would be excluded from targeted strikes.

Geo-Political.title: Why Moscow is staying tight-lipped on Trump's energy ceasefire
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has indicated support for a ceasefire concerning energy infrastructure. Meanwhile, the Russian government has remained largely silent on Donald Trump's proposal.

Geo-Political.title: Documents falsified to evade tax on Abramovich's wealth, BBC finds
Geo-Political.summary: An investigation by the BBC revealed that backdated paperwork was used to falsify documents and evade taxes on Roman Abramovich's wealth. The fraudulent documents also concealed the Russian oligarch's yachts and mansions from his financial accounts.

Geo-Political.title: Saudi minister vows 'serious response' to Houthi attacks on airports
Geo-Political.summary: A Saudi minister promised a serious response after Houthi attacks on two airports killed 13 people. This escalation involved strikes on Riyadh's international airport and another facility.

Geo-Political.title: Breaking Bad actor RJ Mitte dies aged 34
Geo-Political.summary: Actor RJ Mitte, best known for playing Walter White Jr. in the television series Breaking Bad, has died at the age of 34. Mitte, who lived with cerebral palsy, starred in the Emmy-winning drama throughout its run.

Geo-Political.title: South Africa's deputy police chief resigns after being charged with sexual offences
Geo-Political.summary: South Africa's deputy police chief, Shadrack Sibiya, has resigned after being charged with sexual offences. Sibiya has denied allegations that he groomed a 16-year-old and raped an 18-year-old.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates a shift in how organic traffic is generated through artificial intelligence compared to traditional search engine optimization.

Data & Insights.title: India, UK to exchange tariff usage data under trade agreement
Data & Insights.summary: Starting in July 2027, India and the UK will annually exchange tariff usage data under their trade agreement. This initiative is designed to help small businesses benefit from lower import duties and overcome early operational challenges.

Data & Insights.title: US tariffs accelerate global trade realignment: How India’s FTAs could boost GDP
Data & Insights.summary: Bloomberg Economics reports that India's expanding free trade agreements could add $140 billion to its GDP and increase exports by 6.2% by 2035. This growth will be shaped by ongoing global supply chain shifts and new United States tariffs.

Data & Insights.title: FTAs may add $140bn to India GDP by 2035, lift exports 6.2%: Bloomberg Economics
Data & Insights.summary: Free trade agreements could increase India's GDP by $140 billion and boost exports by 6.2% by 2035, according to a Bloomberg Economics report. These economic gains could rise to $170 billion if India successfully finalizes pending trade deals with the US, EAEU, GCC, and Israel.

Data & Insights.title: India sees 5% drop in job postings in Q2, fares better than major economies: Bain & Company
Data & Insights.summary: India's job postings decreased by 5% year-on-year in the second quarter of 2026, though the country performed better than major global economies. Meanwhile, global job openings for artificial intelligence increased by 60% to approximately 351,000.

Data & Insights.title: AI could lift India’s GDP growth by 0.4–0.9 percentage point annually. Which jobs and industries stand to gain?
Data & Insights.summary: Artificial intelligence could increase India's annual GDP growth by 0.4 to 0.9 percentage point depending on infrastructure development and IT sector shifts. However, automation risks worsening unemployment and economic inequality if new jobs are not created.

Data & Insights.title: Inflation breaches RBI’s 4% target for fourth straight month
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation reached a 23-month high of 5.54% in September, exceeding the Reserve Bank of India's 4% target for the fourth consecutive month. This increase was driven by rising food and commodity costs, complicating the central bank's price stability efforts.

India.title: Jagtar Singh Hawara Could Be Out Of Jail Soon: Group After Meeting Bhagwant Mann
India.summary: A group campaigning for Jagtar Singh Hawara stated that Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann has assured them the state will support moving Hawara to a Punjab prison. This support will be presented by the state's Advocate General during a Supreme Court hearing scheduled for Tuesday.

India.title: Akali Dal's Big Focus On Women In Punjab, Through Drugs, Financial Help
India.summary: Akali MP Harsimrat Kaur Badal addressed a women's gathering in Bathinda to criticize the Bhagwant Mann government. She accused the administration of failing to fulfill promises made to women and neglecting to stop drug trafficking.

India.title: In TVS Succession Row, No Agreement Yet On Division Of Family Wealth
India.summary: The century-old TVS Group conglomerate has not yet reached an agreement on dividing the family wealth among its heirs. Founded by TV Sundaram Iyengar, the business empire operates across the automotive, auto component, and financial services sectors.

India.title: 'Buy Biryani From Hindu Shops' Posters Surface In Bengal Ahead Of Durga Puja
India.summary: Posters urging people to buy biryani and puja articles exclusively from Hindu-owned shops appeared in West Bengal ahead of Durga Puja. According to the Hindu Jagaran Manch, these posters were not intended as a directive.

India.title: Enforcement Directorate Searches 8 Locations In Kolkata In Laundering Case
India.summary: The Enforcement Directorate searched eight locations in Kolkata as part of a money laundering investigation. The case involves allegations of financial fraud centered around false promises of high investment returns.

India.title: Heavy Rain Triggers Waterlogging In Gurugram, Faridabad, Traffic Disrupted
India.summary: Heavy rainfall caused waterlogging and traffic disruptions in Gurugram and Faridabad. During the storm, Gurugram received approximately 40 mm of rain while Faridabad recorded 12 mm.

General.title: Burnham to push for new post-Brexit deals at EU summit
General.summary: Andy Burnham plans to push for new post-Brexit deals during an upcoming European Union summit. In response, Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch accused the prime minister of unpicking the existing UK-EU agreement.

General.title: Government expands police support to political figures who are not MPs
General.summary: The UK government is expanding police security to political figures who are not members of parliament. Justice Secretary Shabana Mahmood stated that current measures provide insufficient protection for individuals playing a role in public life.

General.title: Six Ukrainian energy sites hit by Russia since Trump announced ceasefire, Zelensky says
General.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy stated that Russia has struck six Ukrainian energy sites since U.S. President Trump announced a ceasefire covering such infrastructure. Ukraine reports that these targeted attacks have continued despite the agreement.

General.title: Why Moscow is staying tight-lipped on Trump's energy ceasefire
General.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has indicated support for a proposed ceasefire on energy infrastructure. Meanwhile, the Russian government has remained largely silent on the initiative.

General.title: Abramovich's close associate misled UK court in £1bn oil-fields case, documents suggest
General.summary: Court documents suggest that Eugene Tenenbaum, a close associate of Roman Abramovich, misled a UK court during a £1 billion oil-fields legal battle. Tenenbaum, a former Chelsea FC director, reportedly helped manage the sanctioned oligarch's vast wealth.

General.title: On Yemen's desert battlefield, a war with global consequences is being waged
General.summary: Yemen's civil war has become a major global conflict with far-reaching consequences. Despite this, doctors in the port city of Aden operate far removed from the geopolitical crisis.
